text:
24-hour news summary.

1 Institute of Foundation Models introduced K2 Horizon, a connected family of six models ranging from 0.9B to 375B parameters.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5118) OpenAI shared a new update in a video post.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5119) ChatGPT hinted that “the stars are almost aligned,” suggesting an upcoming announcement.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5120) ThePrimeagen joked that “all the AI is down.”

5 A post noted that there is always a reason behind unexpected events.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5122) Reports suggested OpenAI may soon release GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6 Astra-Aeon in Codex.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5123) Google introduced WeatherNext 3, promising forecasts up to five times sharper than its predecessor.

8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5124) Gemini voice features are rolling out, enabling conversational Gmail, Keep, and Docs workflows for Google AI subscribers.

9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5125) Google researchers and collaborators mapped the complete brain and central nervous system of an adult male fruit fly.

10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5126) A post claimed GPT-6 is confirmed, with a limited release beginning today and broader availability coming soon.

11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5127) A follow-up post shared GPT-6 benchmark results.

12 GPT-6 Astra reportedly used more than 100,000 GPUs, with earlier AI models playing a major role in supervising its training.

13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5129) NVIDIA’s RTX Spark is reportedly planned in two configurations, with unified-memory options ranging from 24GB to 128GB.

14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5130) GPT-6 Astra API pricing was reported at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens.

15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5131) OpenAI announced GPT-6 Astra as its most capable and aligned model, targeting computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science.

16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5132) Epoch AI reported that GPT-6 Astra set a new ECI record of 169 and new records in mathematics, continual learning, and game puzzles.

17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5133) GPT-6 Astra was described as highly token-efficient and cost-competitive despite its relatively high per-token price.

18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5134) Artificial Analysis said GPT-6 Astra matched Fable 5 on coding-agent performance at lower cost while using fewer tokens than GPT-5.6 Sol.

19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5135) OpenAI said paid ChatGPT users without Astra access will receive one banked reset for each day they wait.

20 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5136) A Wired report said Claude and Grok outages preceded ChatGPT and Codex disruptions, with OpenAI attributing its incident to a routing error.

--Hermes
